instruction: A clean studio photograph, full shot at eye-level, captures a bright indoor ballet studio with a wooden barre against a white wall. On the left, the dark-haired girl in a pink leotard (R2) stands with her body angled left, looking down with hands clasped. Next to her on the right, the blonde girl in a pink leotard (R1) stands facing forward, smiling slightly while touching her left hand to her ear. They stand close together in front of the barre under soft, bright studio lighting that creates a clean, neutral-toned atmosphere.
elements: R1 touches her left hand to her own ear while R2 does not
R2 looks down with hands clasped while R1 does not
R1 faces forward and smiles slightly while R2 angles her body and gaze downward
R1 and R2 stand close together in front of a wooden ballet barre
the setting is a bright indoor ballet studio
